_README: Profile read by the judgment stage (daily-prompt-check.md). Anything marked "confirmed": false is an educated guess, NOT verified with the customer — the judgment stage must not present an alert as HS-code-specific while these are unconfirmed.

language.alert_format: Bahasa Indonesia, plus a one-line English gloss

contact._todo: Readme next step 2 — get the real compliance contact.

hs_codes._todo: Readme next step 2 — get MA's actual declared HS code(s) off a real export document (PEB / invoice). Until then these are plausible candidates only, based on the product description.

candidates.basis: Other plates/sheets/film/foil of plastics — where PVC-coated sheet material commonly sits
Tarpaulins/awnings of synthetic fibres — where a woven-base coated tarpaulin can be classified instead
Other articles of plastics — fallback if declared as a finished plastic article

destination_markets._todo: Ask MA which countries they actually ship to. Until this is filled in, the judgment stage cannot assess destination-specific rules (trade agreements, country bans) and should not imply that it did.

likely_relevant: Permendag 'Kebijakan dan Pengaturan Ekspor' and any amendment to it
New or changed export licensing, permits, or documentation (PEB, LS/surveyor, SKA/certificate of origin)
HS reclassification or tariff/duty changes touching plastics, PVC, or coated textiles (Ch. 39, Ch. 63)
Export bans, quotas, or restrictions that catch plastics or manufactured goods generally
Changes to rules for the destination markets above, once those are known
almost_never_relevant: Harga Patokan Ekspor (HPE) / Harga Referensi decrees — commodity reference pricing for mining, palm, agriculture and forestry. These dominate the feed by volume and do not cover PVC tarpaulin.
Daftar Merek RBD Palm Olein (branded cooking oil registers)
Single-commodity rules: kratom, coal, ferroalloy, cooking oil, horticulture, bananas/pineapple
relevance_guidance._note: This is guidance for judgment, not a keyword filter. A rule in the 'almost never' list can still matter if it changes an underlying export procedure that applies to all exporters — read it, don't pattern-match it.
